task.question_description: Give full credit to a response exactly when its entire text, after trimming leading and trailing whitespace and converting letters to lowercase, matches the trusted correct reference label treated the same way. The reference is either True or False. An added explanation or the opposite label does not earn full credit.

analysis_profile.note: These are fixed analysis bindings, native input/reference assumptions, normalization and threshold, supplied by the experiment. They are not inferred from the question. They do not specify which semantic obligations to select.
